title: PaddlePaddle Open-Source Release
summary: PaddlePaddle's official project documentation and Baidu's corporate reporting state that Baidu open-sourced the PaddlePaddle deep-learning framework in 2016.
significance: A year-precision public open-source milestone for Baidu's PaddlePaddle deep-learning framework, preserved without fabricating a day-level release date.

verification.note: The official PaddlePaddle repository states that PaddlePaddle has been officially open-sourced to professional communities since 2016. Baidu's 2024 Form 20-F independently states that PaddlePaddle is Baidu's in-house deep-learning framework and that Baidu open-sourced it in 2016. The available first-party evidence safely supports year precision; this candidate does not invent an exact release day or infer an invention/system-birth date, development geography, universal priority, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationship edges.

candidateMeta.admissionReason: Two first-party sources independently support PaddlePaddle's 2016 open-sourcing, while the evidence reviewed here does not establish a safe exact day-level release date.
